patch.value: Refresh and verify quoted release changelog option names

Follow-up to ops-release-1115-heading-drift and pm-ops PR #295. The changelog verifier reads shell option tokens. The reusable prepare workflow and continuation guard still pattern-match raw hook strings, so they can overlook the same option when its name is quoted.

Exercise the real prepare and continuation paths with quoted option names, quoted date values and equals forms. Both paths must share shell option semantics with the verifier, including ignoring lookalikes inside URL arguments.
Use a hook with "--date-fallback" followed by a quoted 2026-11-16 day. Run date-pin refresh and continuation validation with a 2026-11-17 merge day.
Preparation refreshes or restores each recognized option, and continuation refuses stale pins before publication.
The verifier accepts the shell option. The workflow leaves the stale day in place, and the continuation guard reports no mismatch.
